initial.text: Atlas API: after a rolling update, new pods are repeatedly OOMKilled; old pods remain Ready. Cause unknown.

inspect_rollout.text: Atlas API public Service atlas-api, namespace atlas-demo; old revision r17 and new revision r18. Four old and two new ready pods. New pods report OOMKilled, limit 512 MiB. Nodes have no MemoryPressure.

inspect_configuration.text: Effective RESULT_BUFFER_MIB is 64 in both revisions; payload and concurrency policies unchanged.

inspect_routes.text: The public atlas-api Service selects app=atlas-api,release=r18. EndpointSlices include only the two new ready pods; the four old ready pods are excluded.

inspect_memory.text: Matching window: old pods receive 0 requests/s; each new pod receives 210 requests/s and reaches its 512 MiB limit. New pods at the earlier 70 requests/s load used 240 MiB. RESULT_BUFFER_MIB remains 64.
